title: Bibliothèques Virtuelles Humanistes — Épistémon
notes: Epistemon is the text database of the Bibliothèques Virtuelles Humanistes (BVH) programme at the Centre d'Études Supérieures de la Renaissance, Université de Tours (head: Rémi Jimenes). It offers Renaissance texts (literature and author corpora, literary manuscripts and 16th-century archival documents) transcribed in a 'patrimonial' manner that respects layout, spelling and punctuation, encoded in XML-TEI following the project's TEI-Renaissance guidelines. The first texts went online in 1998 at the University of Poitiers and moved to Tours in 2001; TEI encoding has been used since 2007. Texts are read and searched through XTF, PhiloLogic and TXM, with facsimiles shown alongside where available. Fidelity levels of older transcriptions are heterogeneous, and the base is still being extended and revised. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: The Epistemon editorial principles and the BVH legal notice (mentions.asp) place the texts under 'Creative Commons Attribution - NonCommercial - ShareAlike 4.0 International'. Library-owned originals and images remain under the holding institutions' rights; the site footer still links an older CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 FR badge.
